messages:
sara (partnerships): quick sync — Datadog asks for a small joint announcement + a lightweight dashboard tile for the marketplace listing. can we scope?

mike (obs): +1. baseline ask is: trace spans for model calls, latency p50/p95, GPU utilization. also a token-cost chart would be nice.

alex (eng-runtime): doable. need to confirm what exported spans look like. we currently emit span names like `inference.request` and attach model_name + seq_len. can add attributes for quantization/variant.

annie @datadog: thanks — that naming aligns. for the tile we need 3 widgets: latency (histogram or p95), traces (linked to span filter), and a heatmap for GPU mem/UTIL. lightweight json template is ideal.

sara (partnerships): timeline? Datadog wants a marketplace submission next week to hit their release. is a trimmed template + docs plausible by Tue?

alex (eng-runtime): can produce a draft tile json + small example OTLP exporter snippet by Mon EOD. need someone to review content for public docs.

lina (product): i can review the messaging and compliance check. also let's agree on what to call the tile in the marketplace copy. short name: "Redwood Inference — Observability Pack"?

mike (obs): prefer "Redwood Inference: Tracing & Metrics" — clearer for customers.

sara (partnerships): agreed with mike. lina will own copy. alex + mike to drop artifacts. annie — can you confirm Datadog's submission checklist so we don't miss any required fields?

annie @datadog: sure — main items: tile json, sample dashboard screenshot (PNG), integration README (how to wire OTLP/Datadog agent), minimum supported span attrs, and contact email for support. also needs a short 150 char blurb.

alex (eng-runtime): sample OTLP snippet for customers (python) — posting here:

```
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.grpc.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter

# set attributes on inference spans
with tracer.start_as_current_span("inference.request", attributes={"model": "redwood/turbo-13b", "seq_len": 512}):
    call_inference()

# OTLP env
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT="https://otel.collector.example"
```

will include full file in PR.

mike (obs): small ask: include a note about sampling — recommend keeping 100% traces for canary customers, 10% for large volume. and a short recipe for correlating traces to logs (request_id header).

sara (partnerships): ops-bot — create jira ticket for this deliverable and tag team owners?

ops-bot: created RED-4821: "Datadog marketplace tile + integration docs" — assignees: alex, mike, lina; due: 2026-03-30.

lina (product): i'll draft the 150-char blurb tonight and push to the doc. can someone add a 2-line partner co-sell blurb for press?

annie @datadog: i'll add a co-sell sentence and a logo svg. include legal review? small logos fine, but will need partner logo usage confirmation.

alex (eng-runtime): one technical question: should we expose cache hit ratio as a metric? could be useful to show cost savings.

mike (obs): yes — added to widget backlog. helpful for customers evaluating dedupe/prefix-caching.

sara (partnerships): summary: alex produces tile json + OTLP sample by Mon, mike creates widget mappings & review, lina final copy + legal check, annie supplies Datadog checklist + logo. target submit Tue to Datadog marketplace. thanks all :rocket:

annie @datadog: great — ping me if you need early access to their marketplace portal for previews.

sara (partnerships): noted. closing loop here — will post Jira link and doc PR when ready.
